nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used for authentication and as the acting account in user-facing functions.
Block-time dependence (block.number / block timestamp) driving interest accrual and COMP index updates.
Adds a list of cToken markets to msg.sender's assets-in list.
Internal helper writing market membership and pushing cToken into accountAssets.
Removes a market from msg.sender's assets-in, mutating the stored array in place.
Policy hook validating mint, called by cToken; updates COMP supply index.
Policy hook validating redeem via liquidity check and updating COMP.
Internal liquidity-based redeem/transfer permission check.
Policy hook validating borrow, borrow caps and oracle price before accruing COMP.
Policy hook validating repay; is the only touch point for repay in the comptroller.
Policy hook validating liquidation, shortfall and close factor bound.
Policy hook validating collateral seizure across markets.
Policy hook validating cToken transfer, delegating to redeemAllowedInternal.
Core liquidity engine summing collateral and borrow effects using oracle prices.
Computes collateral tokens to seize from repayment amount, incentive and prices.
Admin function replacing the price oracle.
Admin function setting the liquidation close factor.
Admin function setting per-market collateral factor with bounds and price checks.
Admin function setting the liquidation incentive.
Admin function listing a new cToken market.
Admin/guardian function writing per-market borrow caps.
Admin function changing the borrow cap guardian.
Admin function changing the pause guardian.
Guardian/admin function toggling the mint pause flag for a market.
Upgrade entry point accepting a new implementation from the unitroller admin.
Claims accrued COMP for a set of holders across markets.
Internal COMP payout using the external COMP token balance.
Admin function granting COMP to a recipient.
Admin function setting per-contributor COMP speed and checkpoint block.
Accrues COMP to a market supply index using block delta.
Accrues COMP to a market borrow index using block delta.
Returns the current block number (time source for the flywheel).
Admin-only initializer of a money market.
Internal ERC20 transfer applying allowances and balances.
Sets allowance for msg.sender.
Supplies underlying and mints cTokens after hook checks and transfer-in.
Redeems cTokens/underlying, performing transfer-out and balance writes.
Borrows underlying to the borrower after hook and cash checks.
Repays a borrow by pulling tokens in and updating borrow accounting.
Liquidates a borrower, repaying debt and seizing collateral from another cToken.
Internal collateral seizure updating borrower/liquidator balances.
External seize entry restricted to cToken callers via msg.sender.
Accrues borrow interest over elapsed blocks and writes new totals and index.
Admin function starting the admin transfer.
Pending admin accepts the admin role.
Admin function replacing the comptroller with a marker check.
Admin function reducing reserves and transferring underlying to admin.
Admin function proposing a new implementation brain.
Pending implementation accepts its role, upgrading the proxy target.
Fallback that delegatecalls msg.data into the current implementation.
External call to the configurable price oracle driving liquidity and seizure math.
External transfer of underlying to a user-controlled address before state finalization in several paths.
External pull of underlying tokens from a user, returning the actual received amount.
Delegatecall to the stored implementation address executing arbitrary msg.data in proxy context.
Unchecked / carefully-mathed uint arithmetic on balances, indices and supply.
In-place storage array swap and length decrement in exitMarket that can corrupt state if the invariant breaks.
Privileged administrator address used for authorization checks.
Configurable PriceOracle contract address.
Maximum fraction of a borrow repayable in one liquidation.
Discount multiplier paid to liquidators.
Mapping of cToken address to Market metadata including listing and membership.
Per-account array of entered cToken markets, mutated by push and swap-and-pop.
Per-market borrow cap enforced in borrowAllowed.
Address allowed to pause markets alongside admin.
Mapping of accrued but undistributed COMP per account.
Unitroller implementation address used for delegatecall.
Reentrancy guard flag used by the nonReentrant modifier.
Total outstanding borrows including accrued interest.
Global interest accumulator for the market.
Total cTokens in circulation.
Mapping of account cToken balances.
Mapping of account borrow snapshots (principal and interest index).
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances.
Last block at which interest was accrued; freshness anchor.
Caller-supplied array of cToken addresses to enter.
Loop bound derived from cTokens.length.
Market address passed by the calling cToken.
Requested underlying borrow amount.
Repay amount proposed by the liquidator.
Shortfall returned by the hypothetical liquidity computation.
New close factor supplied by the admin.
New collateral factor supplied by the admin.
Underlying amount to supply.
cToken amount to redeem (mutually exclusive with redeemAmountIn).
MintLocalVars struct holding intermediate mint calculations.
Account for which COMP is claimed.
AccountLiquidityLocalVars struct holding per-asset sums and prices.
Account whose liquidity is computed.
New oracle address proposed by the admin.
New implementation address proposed by the unitroller admin.
Desired pause state for minting in a market.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against admin before the oracle is replaced.
msg.sender must equal admin to change the close factor.
msg.sender must equal admin to change a collateral factor.
msg.sender must equal admin to change the liquidation incentive.
msg.sender must equal admin to list a market.
msg.sender must be admin or borrowCapGuardian to change borrow caps.
msg.sender must equal admin to change the borrow cap guardian.
msg.sender must equal admin to change the pause guardian.
msg.sender must be pauseGuardian or admin to pause a market.
msg.sender must be the unitroller admin to become the implementation.
adminOrInitializing gate checks msg.sender before granting COMP.
msg.sender must equal admin to initialize the market.
msg.sender must equal admin to set a pending admin.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin to accept the admin role.
msg.sender must equal admin to change the comptroller.
msg.sender must equal admin to reduce reserves.
msg.sender must equal admin to propose an implementation.
msg.sender must equal pendingImplementation to accept the implementation role.
msg.sender is used as the borrower enrolled into the markets.
msg.sender is the account exiting the market.
msg.sender is passed as spender and src for transfers.
msg.sender owns the allowance being set.
msg.sender is used as the seizer cToken, not a parameter.
msg.data from the caller is forwarded to the implementation via delegatecall.
Block number is the time source returned to callers.
Interest accrual depends on the elapsed block delta.
COMP supply index accrual depends on block delta.
COMP borrow index accrual depends on block delta.
getBlockNumber supplies the current block to accrueInterest.
getBlockNumber supplies the current block to the supply index update.
getBlockNumber supplies the current block to the borrow index update.
Contributor speed update stores the current block number.
enterMarkets loops calling addToMarketInternal for each cToken.
exitMarket performs a redeem permission check via redeemAllowedInternal.
redeemAllowed delegates the liquidity check to redeemAllowedInternal.
redeemAllowedInternal runs a hypothetical liquidity check.
borrowAllowed may add the borrower to the market.
borrowAllowed performs a hypothetical liquidity check for the borrow.
liquidateBorrowAllowed checks borrower shortfall via liquidity internals.
mintAllowed keeps the flywheel moving by updating the supply index.
redeemAllowed updates the supply index before distributing.
borrowAllowed updates the borrow index before distributing.
repayBorrowAllowed updates the borrow index for the market.
seizeAllowed updates the supply index for collateral distribution.
transferAllowed updates the supply index before distributing.
seize forwards to seizeInternal with msg.sender as the seizer token.
seizeInternal calls the comptroller seizeAllowed hook.
_grantComp pays out through grantCompInternal.
claimComp grants each holder's accrued COMP through grantCompInternal.
mintFresh calls the comptroller mintAllowed policy hook before effects.
redeemFresh calls the comptroller redeemAllowed policy hook.
borrowFresh calls the comptroller borrowAllowed policy hook.
repayBorrowFresh calls the comptroller repayBorrowAllowed hook.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls the comptroller liquidateBorrowAllowed hook.
liquidateBorrowFresh queries seize token amounts from the comptroller.
transferTokens calls the comptroller transferAllowed hook.
Liquidity computation reads prices from the external oracle.
redeemFresh performs an external underlying transfer before writing balances.
borrowFresh transfers underlying out before updating borrow state.
_reduceReservesFresh transfers reserves out to admin before final bookkeeping.
mintFresh pulls underlying in from the minter via an external call.
repayBorrowFresh pulls repayment in from the payer via an external call.
liquidateBorrowFresh externally calls seize on another cToken.
The fallback delegatecalls into a mutable implementation address.
grantCompInternal performs an external COMP token transfer.
_become calls the unitroller _acceptImplementation externally.
exitMarket swaps the last storage array element into an index and decrements length.
accrueInterest multiplies and adds interest, totals and index values.
repayBorrowFresh subtracts the repayment from borrow balances.
borrowFresh adds the borrow amount to account and total borrows.
mintFresh adds minted tokens to supply and account balance.
redeemFresh subtracts redeemed tokens from supply and account balance.
_setCloseFactor writes the closeFactorMantissa state variable.
_setPriceOracle writes the oracle state variable.
borrowAllowed reads the per-market borrow cap.
_setPauseGuardian writes the pauseGuardian state variable.
accrueInterest writes the updated totalBorrows.
initialize and admin functions read the admin state variable.
redeemFresh is protected by the nonReentrant guard flag.
borrowFresh is protected by the nonReentrant guard flag.
The fallback reads the implementation address before delegatecalling.
claimComp reads and zeroes the accrued COMP mapping.
The cTokens array parameter drives the enterMarkets loop.
The len local bounds the enterMarkets loop.
The cToken parameter selects the market being validated.
The borrowAmount parameter feeds cap and liquidity checks.
The repayAmount parameter is compared against the close factor bound.
The shortfall local is produced by the liquidity computation.
The newCloseFactorMantissa parameter is stored by _setCloseFactor.
The newCollateralFactorMantissa parameter is validated and stored.
The mintAmount parameter is transferred in and converted to cTokens.
The redeemTokensIn parameter selects the redemption mode.
The MintLocalVars struct holds mintFresh intermediates.
The holder parameter determines whose COMP is claimed.
AccountLiquidityLocalVars accumulates collateral and borrow sums.
The account parameter selects whose assets are iterated.
The newOracle parameter is assigned into the oracle state variable.
The newPendingImplementation parameter is stored as pending implementation.
The state parameter toggles the guardian pause flags.

normalization_plan.reason: The cToken array parameter only exists to drive the enterMarkets loop and should be folded into that function node.
The len local is a loop bound derived from the input array and carries no independent semantics.
The cToken parameter is only used to index markets inside borrowAllowed.
borrowAmount is consumed by the cap and liquidity checks within borrowAllowed.
repayAmount is only compared against maxClose inside the liquidation hook.
Shortfall is the direct return value of the liquidity computation and should be merged with it.
The parameter is validated and written to storage directly by the admin setter.
The parameter is bounds-checked and stored by the collateral factor setter.
mintAmount is the sole quantity input that mintFresh converts into cTokens.
redeemTokensIn only selects which redemption branch redeemFresh executes.
MintLocalVars is a transient stack struct scoped entirely to mintFresh.
holder is the account whose accrued COMP is claimed inside claimComp.
AccountLiquidityLocalVars is the accumulator used only by the liquidity engine.
The account parameter selects the accountAssets entry iterated by the liquidity engine.
newOracle is assigned to the oracle state variable inside the setter.
The parameter is directly stored as pendingImplementation.
The state parameter is written into the market pause flag.
